decision_review_changed: This decision has changed or was already handled. Refresh before trying again.
decision_review_fields: This request is missing a valid review time or Undo receipt.
draft_changed: This draft has changed or is no longer pending. Refresh before trying again.
draft_dismissed: You chose not to handle this draft. Undo that decision before sending it.
draft_decision_question: Reply drafted from the task’s progress
draft_decision_ignore: Do not handle this draft; do not send a reply. Keep the task and agent open.
draft_decision_undo: Undo the decision not to handle this draft; return it to pending without sending a reply.
plan_waiting: {n} things are waiting for you to start
plan_waiting_single: Something is waiting for you to start
fixed_launcher_unhealthy: Launcher {launcher} is unavailable on fixed computer {machine}: {reason}. This task stays on that computer; retry after its health recovers.
launcher_not_on_machine: Launcher {launcher} isn’t on {machine}, so nothing was started. Launchers that computer has: {launchers}
launcher_swapped: {launcher} isn’t on {machine}, so this runs on {to} with its default model
start_identity_conflict: The start response did not identify a session on the requested computer.
start_interrupted: The hub restarted while this task’s agent was starting. The earlier request may still finish. Check the computer’s sessions after it reconnects before retrying to avoid starting a second agent.
ask_held_title: A card in “{name}” waits for its supervisor
task_failed_body: {reason}. Open the conversation to tap “Retry”, or assign to another computer
task_failed_body_no_reason: Open the conversation to tap “Retry”, or assign to another computer
not_retryable: Only a task that didn’t start, or was interrupted by a model service error, can be retried
not_in_plan: Can’t find this task’s plan, so it can’t be started again as it was
machine_offline: “{name}” is offline. Try again once it’s connected.
silent_turn: This turn had no output: the agent didn’t reply or call any tools (the model service may have returned nothing)
interrupted: Interrupted by a model service error
check_side_turn: The last reply didn’t report on this task
route_no_task: This chat doesn’t have that task
route_no_agent: This task has no running agent
route_agents_stopped: Every agent of this task has stopped, so nothing was sent. A message on the task starts a new agent for it.
adopt_failed: Could not take it under supervision: {reason}
admission_no_metrics: This computer has not reported resource metrics.
admission_stale: This computer's resource metrics are stale.
admission_no_cores: This computer's core count is not reported.
admission_memory_ambiguous: This computer's memory figures are missing or ambiguous.
admission_memory: Only {available} of free memory left, below its limit of {limit}.
admission_procs: {count} claude processes are already running, at its limit of {limit}.
admission_direction_full: This direction already has {running} agents running, at its limit of {limit}.
admission_queued: Queued, the hub will retry automatically: {reason}
admission_queue_timeout: Still queued after {limit} of waiting, so the start is given up. Last reason: {reason}
start_link_lost: The connection to “{machine}” dropped, and after it reconnected the task had not started: {reason}
start_machine_busy: “{machine}” stayed connected but did not answer in time (it may be too busy): {reason}
start_link_down: The connection to “{machine}” dropped and did not come back in time: {reason}
